historical_references.context: The early Islamic conquests expanded the territory of the Islamic Caliphate from the Arabian Peninsula to include much of the Middle East, North Africa, and the Iberian Peninsula.

historical_references.reference: Juyal was also a term used to describe the administrative divisions of the Fatimid Caliphate in Egypt during the 11th and 12th centuries. Each juyal was a district with its own governor and administrative center.
